caption:
Your body does this when you wear wet socks - it may do something to keep you warm, 
   but what about your feet?
comments_seeded: What happens to your feet when they're wet for too long, is it just a matter of discomfort?
I've noticed my feet can get pretty smelly when I wear wet socks, is that linked to something specific?
Do you guys make a point to change into dry socks as soon as you can, or is it not a big deal?
It's interesting how something as simple as wet socks can affect our daily comfort, right?
Have you ever had any issues with your feet because of wearing wet socks, what did you do about it?
